name: college-admission-ai
description: AI-powered college admission assistant for RISE Krishna Sai Prakasam Group of Institutions using IBM watsonx Orchestrate and a grounded RAG knowledge source.

project.title: College Admission Agent (RAG Based)
project.institution: RISE Krishna Sai Prakasam Group of Institutions
project.problem_statement: Build a RAG-powered college admission agent that retrieves and summarizes admission policies, eligibility criteria and FAQs from institutional databases or official sources; answers natural-language questions; helps with course selection, application guidance, fee structure and important deadlines; and uses trusted information.
project.implementation: IBM watsonx Orchestrate agent with a connected RISE college admission knowledge source and an embedded web chat.

rag.knowledge_source: Official RISE Krishna Sai Prakasam Group of Institutions admission information
rag.grounding_policy: Use the connected knowledge source as the primary factual source; do not invent fees, eligibility, deadlines, courses or other institutional facts.

notes: The final implementation uses IBM watsonx Orchestrate and its connected knowledge source.
The live deployed agent is configured with Watsonx Orchestrate Frontier; this file does not claim that the live agent uses IBM Granite.
No API keys, credentials, private keys or secrets are included.
